description: Linker region FLASH overflow - firmware too large for flash memory
compiler_output:
/usr/bin/ld: region `FLASH' overflowed by 123456 bytes
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
user_question: Linker says region FLASH overflowed. What does this mean?
expected_root_cause: Firmware size exceeds available flash memory - large_lookup_table (500KB) doesn't fit
expected_fix: Reduce lookup table size, use compression, or move to external flash; check linker script FLASH region size

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Reduce table size or store in external memory

expected_compiler_messages.likely_cause: Firmware image larger than available flash memory
expected_compiler_messages.suggested_fix: Reduce code/data size or use MCU with larger flash

expected_follow_up_required: Check MCU datasheet for actual flash size and linker script
